title: Flail +2

sources.title: Tenacity
markers: | description = When you miss a melee attack, you deal {{DamageText|[[Strength]] [[Modifier]]|Bludgeoning}} damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

fields.Tenacity: In the main hand, a missed melee attack can spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning damage equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by a Blasphemous Acolyte in the final fight if a Cleric is in the party.
fields.Base value: 155 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
